collection.title: Citroen C5 Estate 2008 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C5 Estate 2008 to 2017 model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this C5 Estate, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
